title: Former Texas teacher admits stealing $520,000 in tax refunds as $4m more is stopped
summary_full: In a shocking turn of events, former Texas teacher Jeremy Jarod Jackson confessed to orchestrating a scheme that siphoned off $520,000 in tax refunds. He masterfully altered his company's mailing address to funnel cheques into his own hands, triggering extensive financial wrongdoing. Luckily, IRS Criminal Investigation agents intervened, blocking Jackson from cashing in on an additional $4 million in fraudulent cheques.
